title: Comparable aesthetic outcomes of a hybrid modified intraoral vertico-sagittal ramus osteotomy and sagittal split ramus osteotomy technique versus conventional bilateral sagittal split ramus osteotomy for asymmetric…
html: Conventional bilateral sagittal split ramus osteotomy (BSSRO) for asymmetric mandibular prognathism carries risks to the temporomandibular joints and inferior alveolar nerve. A hybrid technique, combining a modified L-shaped intraoral vertico-sagittal ramus osteotomy (mIVSRO) with a contralateral SSRO, may mitigate these risks, but its aesthetic outcomes are unproven. The aim of this study was to compare the aesthetic efficacy of the hybrid versus conventional BSSRO techniques, adjusting for baseline asymmetry.
